text:
Maya: quick Q — we're kicking off the post-webinar nurture + launch email sequence. want to confirm segmentation + inbound routing for webinar signups vs blog downloads. target send window Mon 03/02 10:00am PST. any concerns?
Kevin: I can build the segmentation matrix. propose 3 cohorts: Webinar attendees, Registrants (no-show), Content downloaders. different subject lines + CTAs per cohort. enterprise leads get "Dedicated demo" CTA. @Zoe can confirm sales routing?
Eliot: yes — enterprise leads should route to Sales High-Touch if company_size > 250 or domain matches enterprise allowlist. we should also enrich with job_title and existing_product_flag. we'll expose a webhook at /lead-router. example rule payload: 
```json
{
  "source":"webinar",
  "company_size":"$>250",
  "route":"sales_high_touch",
  "notify":"#sales-inbound"
}
```
Sasha: nurture cadence suggestion: Day 0 = welcome + CTA, Day 3 = benchmark narrative (performance & cost), Day 10 = case study + demo invite. also include a soft survey on Day 7 for intent scoring. A/B test Day 3 subject: 
A) "How teams cut inference cost by 3x"
B) "New benchmark: latency vs cost tradeoffs"
Maya: good. Kevin — can you draft subject variants and the segment-specific CTAs? also we need ESP tags: audience_segment, lead_score, source_campaign, webinar_id, customer_id (for suppression).
Kevin: on it. I'll add suppression rule for existing customers (customer_id != null). I'll also create the excel/csv mapping for tags.
Eliot: routing notes — if lead_score > 80 then immediate slack alert to #sales-ops and route to high-touch. if lead_source == "webinar" and attended == true, boost lead_score +10. example rule snippet: 
```json
{
  "if": ["lead_score > 80"],
  "action": ["slack_notify:#sales-ops","route:sales_high_touch"]
}
```
Zoe: Sales ack — we'll follow up within 24h for high-touch leads. please include a Calendly link in the high-touch CTA. Also add company_size and ARR estimate in the payload so we can prioritize. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: [deployed] lead-router rule v3 -> prod at 2025-10-14T14:02:03Z :rocket:
Maya: final check — Kevin and Sasha pair on Day 3 benchmark copy. I'll own send window + suppression lists. anyone object to 10am PST? remember APAC recipients should get a local-time send (10am local) if present.
Sasha: fine with 10am PST. will create alternate send windows for APAC and EMEA.
Kevin: drafting subjects + copy now, will push to Google Doc and tag @Maya and @Zoe. ETA: tomorrow EOD.
Maya: perfect — once Kevin posts the doc I'll flag the ESP build and QA steps. thanks all!
